title: Egg Fried Rice
intro: Remember, it’s your taste buds dancing to their own unique tune, and nobody else gets to dictate the melody!
method: Add chilli oil to the pan and cook your eggs for a few minutes
Take out of the pan and add in the onions + ginger + garlic
Saute till translucent then add in the mushrooms, cook till water evaporates

Nutrition: 
C: 46 | F: 8 | P: 14
Calories: 306 per serving
serves 2 or 3 depending on your appetite
(calories mentioned are considering 2 serves, you can divide to 3 serves which comes to around 204 per serve) 

Ingredients
1 tsp chilli oil
2 eggs 
1 onion, finely chopped
1 tbsp minced garlic
1 tbsp minced ginger
200 grams button mushroom, sliced
1 capsicum, cut into cubes
2 cups cooked rice
1 tbsp soy sauce
1 tbsp vinegar
1 - 2 tbsp green chilli sauce

optional: 
carrots, bell pepper, cabbage, 

Method: 
add chilli oil to the pan and cook your eggs for a few minutes
take out of the pan and add in the onions + ginger + garlic
saute till translucent then add in the mushrooms, cook till water evaporates
then add in the capsicum and saute for a minute
add in the cooked rice and all the sauces mentioned above and stir together
add the cooked eggs back in with a generous sprinkle of peppper and bring it together
enjoy :)
